text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar. Second, exercise regularly—even a short walk every day helps. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because rest gives you energy for the next day. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Don't spend all your time working; enjoy hobbies and time with friends and family. Small daily habits can make a big difference.
